description: The B2 Stealth Bomber of Finance” 🐸💣 Behold the ultimate crypto-finance crossover collectible: the PEPEBROOKS trading card — where former OCC head Brian Brooks undergoes glorious Pepe-fication and transforms into a green-skinned, suit-wearing, Bitcoin-spewing financial supervillain (or hero, depending on your portfolio). Floating in a cyberpunk money storm of glowing orange Bitcoins and digital glitch effects, PepeBrooks grins with that signature knowing smirk, flanked by massive pixelated B2 bomber wings made of pure blockchain fire. His lapel proudly sports a Bitcoin pin, because of course it does. The card’s flavor text hits like a stealth mission: “B2 Stealth Bomber = Banks & Bitcoin” Below, our green protagonist drops the red-pill mic: “And that’s when I realized we should stop trying to incrementally improve a system that really cannot fundamentally be fixed, it NEEDS TO BE REPLACED. That’s what Bitcoin is about!” The background is pure chaos — cartoon money printers going brrr, eagles crying “Infinite Money Glitch,” and Zimbabwe-level debasement memes — all while the official Comptroller of the Currency seal watches approvingly from the corner like it’s in on the joke. Final boss flavor at the bottom: BRIAN BROOKS = B2 Stealth This isn’t just a meme. It’s a limited-edition, lore-rich, anti-fiat artifact for the memelord who understands that sometimes the most dangerous weapon in finance… is a frog in a suit with bomber wings. 10/10 would put in the Bitcoin sleeve and never take out.
name: PEPEBROOKS
